name: Level-up cards
notes: Opens on every level the player gains in the waves mode (the world freezes) and shows 3 random cards: Power Gem, Swift Feather, Aim Charm, Mist Orb, Hourglass and Vital Seed, each until it reaches its highest level (NEW! the first time, then LV2, LV3...); the Sun Berry fills in once fewer than 3 are left. Up / Down choose, A takes the card (it can't be skipped). Two levels at once open it twice, one after the other.
title: LEVEL {level}! CHOOSE ONE
